name: Parkin Company PJSC
summary: Parkin Company P.J.S.C. is dedicated to managing and providing paid parking facilities and related services throughout Dubai. Its diverse array of parking solutions extends to public street-level and off-street zones, multi-level parking structures, and spaces situated within developer-owned properties. The company also offers essential services such as permits, seasonal parking subscriptions, and advance booking options for reservations, among other supplementary provisions. Established in 1995, Parkin maintains its corporate headquarters in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
